description.text: A high-class pack released on 2 November 2018 that gathered strong cards of the Sun & Moon series and added shiny Pokémon, drawn in their rare alternate colors. Each pack held ten cards, one of them a Pokémon-GX, and each box held one shiny Pokémon-GX. The ordinary cards also came in mirror holo versions, and some new cards appeared, among them the Supporter Ingo & Emmet. The cards are numbered to 150, followed by full-art Super Rare Supporters such as Cynthia, Guzma and Ingo & Emmet, 45 shiny Pokémon marked S, 38 full-art shiny Pokémon-GX marked SSR, and seven gold Ultra Rare Pokémon-GX: the four island guardians, Solgaleo-GX, Lunala-GX and Ultra Necrozma-GX. In English some of its shiny cards came out in Hidden Fates in August 2019.
